percent at constant currencies to € 9.4 billion.

Global staff shortages make health care professionals the most valuable resource in hospitals. Their
most limited asset is time. Discover solutions to help free up precious time.

][160]

### New standards in sterile processing and operating room supply

A reliable and efficient supply of the OR is essential for creating daily and long-term success in
hospital processes. Digitally enhanced solutions to achieve clinical excellence.

### Sustainability from the depths

With the expansion of its disinfectant production facility in Sempach, Switzerland, B. Braun is now
seizing the opportunity to set new standards in energy management.

precise surgery.

percent at constant currencies to € 9.4 billion.

Global staff shortages make health care professionals the most valuable resource in hospitals. Their
most limited asset is time. Discover solutions to help free up precious time.

][160]

### New standards in sterile processing and operating room supply

A reliable and efficient supply of the OR is essential for creating daily and long-term success in
hospital processes. Digitally enhanced solutions to achieve clinical excellence.

seizing the opportunity to set new standards in energy management.

precise surgery.

# Exceptional People,
# Exceptional Outcomes

## A Medical Device Company Driven by a Shared Mission

As a global medical equipment manufacturer, we embrace a people-first culture that starts with a
mission to support our healthcare partners and the patients they serve. We design, build, and
distribute clinical products and surgical technologies for Orthopedic and General surgical
specialties, as well as patient monitoring needs, to medical institutions around the world —
enabling optimal patient outcomes.

[ Start a Conversation ][166]

### A Boldly Innovative Insufflation Solution

AirSeal^{®} is the only insufflator backed by clinical data* - positively affecting your patients'
intra and postoperative outcomes.

[ Learn More About AirSeal^{®} ][167]
[ Review the Data ][168]

### BioBrace^{®} Reinforced Bioinductive Implant

### The future of healing

The BioBrace^{®} implant combines the biological healing potential of highly porous Type I collagen
with the mechanical strength of PLLA microfilaments to support tendon healing. Engineered to protect
repairs during the vulnerable healing phase, the BioBrace^{®} implant promotes tissue growth,
reduces stress on healing tissue, and supports the body's natural healing processes.

[ Learn More About BioBrace^{®} ][169]
[ See the Data ][170]

### Y-Knotless™ Flex All-Suture Knotless Anchor: Shuttle with Ease. Fixate with Confidence.

The next generation of knotless technology is here with Y-Knotless™ Flex. Engineered for effortless
shuttling and designed to provide color-coded clarity during each step of the procedure.

# Exceptional People,
# Exceptional Outcomes

## A Medical Device Company Driven by a Shared Mission

As a global medical equipment manufacturer, we embrace a people-first culture that starts with a
mission to support our healthcare partners and the patients they serve. We design, build, and
distribute clinical products and surgical technologies for Orthopedic and General surgical
specialties, as well as patient monitoring needs, to medical institutions around the world —
enabling optimal patient outcomes.

### A Boldly Innovative Insufflation Solution

AirSeal^{®} is the only insufflator backed by clinical data* - positively affecting your patients'
intra and postoperative outcomes.

[ Learn More About AirSeal^{®} ][167]
[ Review the Data ][168]

### BioBrace^{®} Reinforced Bioinductive Implant

### The future of healing

The BioBrace^{®} implant combines the biological healing potential of highly porous Type I collagen
with the mechanical strength of PLLA microfilaments to support tendon healing. Engineered to protect
repairs during the vulnerable healing phase, the BioBrace^{®} implant promotes tissue growth,
reduces stress on healing tissue, and supports the body's natural healing processes.

[ Learn More About BioBrace^{®} ][169]
[ See the Data ][170]

### Y-Knotless™ Flex All-Suture Knotless Anchor: Shuttle with Ease. Fixate with Confidence.

The next generation of knotless technology is here with Y-Knotless™ Flex. Engineered for effortless
shuttling and designed to provide color-coded clarity during each step of the procedure.

[ Learn More About Y-Knotless™ Flex ][171]

# Restoring Lives Through Everyday Impact: The Power of Small Actions

[Fiona Heinen]

Fiona Heinen’s journey shows growth, ownership, and patient impact in action. Supporting clinicians
and patients, she’s seen how small actions can change lives.

[ Read More ][141]
[Clement]

# Miracle Hands

[Clement] [ Learn More ][142]
[Amy Mosebrook]

# Living a Fulfilled Life

[Amy Mosebrook] [ Learn More ][143]

## Restoring Lives

Our commitment to restoring lives has been fundamental in making us a global leader in medical
technologies and providing innovative solutions in surgical, neurologic and regenerative care. At
Integra, we work with one central goal: to create healthier people, a healthier workplace and a
healthier world.

[ View our 2024 ESG Report ][144]
[Woman on mountain]

## Unleashing Possibilities in Patient Care

[ [brain scans]

### Neuro

We are the global leader in neurosurgery, offering a broad portfolio of products and solutions for
dural access and repair, cerebral spinal fluid management and neuro-critical care.
][145] [ [Doctors suturing]

### Wound Reconstruction and Care

Our versatile and evidence-based regenerative technologies for soft tissue reconstruction will
treat, repair and protect patients with acute and chronic complex wounds and burns.
][146] [ [Doctor in surgery wearing magnifying lenses]

### Surgical Reconstruction

We provide advanced solutions for plastic and reconstructive surgery, complex hernias, and nerve and
tendon repair and protection that support the body's natural restorative healing process.
][147] [ [Medical professional organizing medical tools on a tray]

### Surgical Instrumentation and Lighting

Explore the technological advancements in instrumentation and lighting; our solutions play a vital
role before, during and after a medial procedure leading to better patient outcomes.
][148] [ [Doctor performing a procedure on a patient's ear]

### Ear, Nose and Throat

Partnering with physicians to deliver new technology that enables safe, fast and effective
treatments in ENT.
][149]

# Restoring Lives Through Everyday Impact: The Power of Small Actions

[Fiona Heinen]

Fiona Heinen’s journey shows growth, ownership, and patient impact in action. Supporting clinicians
and patients, she’s seen how small actions can change lives.

[ Read More ][141]
[Clement]

# Miracle Hands

[Clement] [ Learn More ][142]
[Amy Mosebrook]

# Living a Fulfilled Life

[Amy Mosebrook] [ Learn More ][143]

## Restoring Lives

Our commitment to restoring lives has been fundamental in making us a global leader in medical
technologies and providing innovative solutions in surgical, neurologic and regenerative care. At
Integra, we work with one central goal: to create healthier people, a healthier workplace and a
healthier world.

[ View our 2024 ESG Report ][144]
[Woman on mountain]

## Unleashing Possibilities in Patient Care

[ [brain scans]

### Neuro

We are the global leader in neurosurgery, offering a broad portfolio of products and solutions for
dural access and repair, cerebral spinal fluid management and neuro-critical care.
][145] [ [Doctors suturing]

### Wound Reconstruction and Care

Our versatile and evidence-based regenerative technologies for soft tissue reconstruction will
treat, repair and protect patients with acute and chronic complex wounds and burns.
][146] [ [Doctor in surgery wearing magnifying lenses]

### Surgical Reconstruction

We provide advanced solutions for plastic and reconstructive surgery, complex hernias, and nerve and
tendon repair and protection that support the body's natural restorative healing process.
][147] [ [Medical professional organizing medical tools on a tray]

### Surgical Instrumentation and Lighting

Explore the technological advancements in instrumentation and lighting; our solutions play a vital
role before, during and after a medial procedure leading to better patient outcomes.
][148] [ [Doctor performing a procedure on a patient's ear]

### Ear, Nose and Throat

Partnering with physicians to deliver new technology that enables safe, fast and effective
treatments in ENT.
][149]

# Celebrating 170 years

A legacy of healthcare innovation. A future without limits.

Discover our story

# Life Unlimited

Smith+Nephew is a portfolio medical technology company focused on the repair, regeneration and
replacement of soft and hard tissue. We exist to restore people's bodies and their self-belief by
using technology to take the limits off living.

[Sports Medicine]

# Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

Explore sports medicine

# Ultimate victory

Hear the story of how our technology, in the hands of a leading surgeon, helped Tom Aspinall recover
from a career-threatening injury to become the UFC world heavyweight champion.

## Smith+Nephew's top products

[ALLEVYN-LIFE-HERO-1-840x840-PX.png]

#### ALLEVYN^{◊} LIFE Foam Dressings

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help
improve efficiency and patient satisfaction in community wound care,^{*4-7 }and have been shown to
support pressure injury prevention protocols^{8,9}
[ View product ][80]
[REGENETEN implant on RCR image from animation]

#### REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant

Bioinductive collagen scaffold for tendon repair.^{1-3} Resorbed and replaced by new tendon-like
tissue within 6 months to support tendon healing.1,2,4-8
[ View product ][81]
[Hero 1 CORI Surgical System.png]

#### CORI^{◊} Surgical System

Combine your skill with handheld robotics and digital surgery applications across a range of joint
arthroplasty indications. Experience the power of one platform.
[ View product ][82]
[Tula Tympanostomy Kit]

#### Tula^{®} Tympanostomy System

An in-office alternative to traditional tympanostomy using a revolutionary, local anesthesia system
and an automated, 1-click tube delivery device.^{1,2}
[ View product ][83]
[Close up of EDGE, front]

#### RENASYS^{◊} EDGE Negative Pressure Wound Therapy System

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced
intuitiveness and simplicity, with a durable pump built to offer maintenance-free use^{*1-3}
[ View product ][84]
[41813 CARTIHEAL Product Page Hero Image V2]

#### CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage Repair Implant

A single-stage, off-the-shelf solution for knee cartilage and osteochondral defects, with or without
mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.
[ View product ][85]
[JOURNEYII_BCS_ROX_RoundPatella_AngledView_onWhite.png]

#### JOURNEY II^{◊} ROX^{◊} Total Knee Solution with CONCELOC^{◊} and OXINIUM^{◊} Technologies

Combining cemented and cementless technologies for a reverse hybrid approach, we bring to the stage
our latest and greatest in joint reconstruction
[ View product ][86]
[COR22-33747-V1-ProjectsAlchemy-AirwayMgmt-Hero-1122.png]

#### COBLATION^{◊} Technology for Airway Management

Designed for precise tissue removal^{1-5 }with a low thermal profile⁶
[ View product ][87]

## Transforming lives

Learn how our history and our passion drive us to strengthen, accelerate and transform the future of
medical technology

## Wound Care

Smith+Nephew's Wound Care (Advanced Wound Management) portfolio provides comprehensive solutions to
meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

[GettyImages-1448442087-CUT-OUT-SHAPE.png]

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

[ View all ][88]

### Wound care products

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

[ Explore sports medicine ][90]
[Homepage Sports Medicine business unit teaser]

## Orthopaedic Reconstruction

Smith+Nephew's Orthopaedics portfolio includes an innovative range of hip and knee implants used to
replace diseased, damaged or worn joints, robotics-assisted and enabling technologies, and services
that empower surgeons. It also includes trauma products used to stabilise severe fractures and
correct bone deformities.

[ Explore orthopaedic reconstruction ][91]

## Smith+Nephew's top products

[ALLEVYN-LIFE-HERO-1-840x840-PX.png]

#### ALLEVYN^{◊} LIFE Foam Dressings

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help
improve efficiency and patient satisfaction in community wound care,^{*4-7 }and have been shown to
support pressure injury prevention protocols^{8,9}
[ View product ][80]
[REGENETEN implant on RCR image from animation]

#### REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant

Bioinductive collagen scaffold for tendon repair.^{1-3} Resorbed and replaced by new tendon-like
tissue within 6 months to support tendon healing.1,2,4-8
[ View product ][81]
[Hero 1 CORI Surgical System.png]

#### CORI^{◊} Surgical System

Combine your skill with handheld robotics and digital surgery applications across a range of joint
arthroplasty indications. Experience the power of one platform.
[ View product ][82]
[Tula Tympanostomy Kit]

#### Tula^{®} Tympanostomy System

An in-office alternative to traditional tympanostomy using a revolutionary, local anesthesia system
and an automated, 1-click tube delivery device.^{1,2}
[ View product ][83]
[Close up of EDGE, front]

#### RENASYS^{◊} EDGE Negative Pressure Wound Therapy System

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced
intuitiveness and simplicity, with a durable pump built to offer maintenance-free use^{*1-3}
[ View product ][84]
[41813 CARTIHEAL Product Page Hero Image V2]

#### CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage Repair Implant

A single-stage, off-the-shelf solution for knee cartilage and osteochondral defects, with or without
mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.
[ View product ][85]
[JOURNEYII_BCS_ROX_RoundPatella_AngledView_onWhite.png]

#### JOURNEY II^{◊} ROX^{◊} Total Knee Solution with CONCELOC^{◊} and OXINIUM^{◊} Technologies

Combining cemented and cementless technologies for a reverse hybrid approach, we bring to the stage
our latest and greatest in joint reconstruction
[ View product ][86]
[COR22-33747-V1-ProjectsAlchemy-AirwayMgmt-Hero-1122.png]

#### COBLATION^{◊} Technology for Airway Management

Designed for precise tissue removal^{1-5 }with a low thermal profile⁶
[ View product ][87]

## Transforming lives

Learn how our history and our passion drive us to strengthen, accelerate and transform the future of
medical technology

## Wound Care

Smith+Nephew's Wound Care (Advanced Wound Management) portfolio provides comprehensive solutions to
meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

[GettyImages-1448442087-CUT-OUT-SHAPE.png]

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

[ View all ][88]

### Wound care products

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

[ Explore sports medicine ][90]
[Homepage Sports Medicine business unit teaser]

## Orthopaedic Reconstruction

Smith+Nephew's Orthopaedics portfolio includes an innovative range of hip and knee implants used to
replace diseased, damaged or worn joints, robotics-assisted and enabling technologies, and services
that empower surgeons. It also includes trauma products used to stabilise severe fractures and
correct bone deformities.

Frequently Asked Questions

## Answers for International Patients

Our international patient advisors are here to help you, 24/7.

**Still have questions?** [Talk to an Advisor][77]
01What exactly does Acıbadem Health Point do for me?

We are your single point of contact for treatment in Türkiye — reviewing your case with the right
specialists, building a clear plan and estimate, and coordinating every detail from your first
question to your recovery back home.

02How do I start, and what does it cost to ask?

Share your reports or simply describe your situation. A specialist reviews your case and you receive
a tailored plan with transparent cost information. The initial assessment costs you nothing.

03Can I speak to a doctor before deciding to travel?

Yes. You can request a written second opinion or a secure video consultation with an Acıbadem
specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

A dedicated multilingual team and professional interpreters support you before, during and after
treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

05Are the hospitals and doctors truly world-class?

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

Frequently Asked Questions

## Answers for International Patients

Our international patient advisors are here to help you, 24/7.

**Still have questions?** [Talk to an Advisor][77]
01What exactly does Acıbadem Health Point do for me?

We are your single point of contact for treatment in Türkiye — reviewing your case with the right
specialists, building a clear plan and estimate, and coordinating every detail from your first
question to your recovery back home.

02How do I start, and what does it cost to ask?

Share your reports or simply describe your situation. A specialist reviews your case and you receive
a tailored plan with transparent cost information. The initial assessment costs you nothing.

03Can I speak to a doctor before deciding to travel?

Yes. You can request a written second opinion or a secure video consultation with an Acıbadem
specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

A dedicated multilingual team and professional interpreters support you before, during and after
treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

05Are the hospitals and doctors truly world-class?

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

# Your Trusted Source for Security, AV and Smart Living Solutions

ADI is a leading distributor and solution provider of security, AV, and smart living products
serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,
including top-tier distributed brands and our own exclusive brands.

With more than three decades of industry experience, we're committed to building long-lasting
customer relationships - making us a preferred partner for professionals across the industry.

# Our Mission

### We aim to provide products, services and software that help keep our communities safe, secure,
### comfortable and connected.

## Here's How We Do It

### Access to Exclusive Brands

We take pride in our exclusive, in-house manufactured products and software solutions, delivering
smart solutions that combine quality and innovation. From home automation to commercial-grade
infrastructure, we craft technologies that focus on what customers value most – delivering a
reliable and exceptional experience

[Access to Exclusive Brands]
[Support and Services]

### Support and Services

We offer a wide range of support and services to provide expert guidance at every step - from design
and configuration to ongoing support. With OvrC Remote Management, customers can easily manage,
configure, and troubleshoot devices across the network. OvrC is available on a range of exclusive
brand products and integrates with many leading distributed brands. Additional offerings include
systems design, technical support, rewards programs, training, project registration, and more.

### Robust Product Selection

With more than 500,000 products from over 1,000 trusted brands, ADI offers a carefully curated
selection of solutions to meet the needs for any application. We make purchasing easy - customers
can shop in-store or online and choose from multiple delivery options or in-store pickup.

[Robust Product Selection]

[ JOURNEY WITH US ][64]

Bioinnovation Venture Accelerator Bridging the translation Gap: Idea to Exit


Esco Aster is a biotech factory helping to spin out our existing Tide Motion bioprocess products
and/or services with the fastest time to clinic, using our standardized, linearly scalable
biomanufacturing platforms that are globally investable and backed by an exit strategy ensuring
returns to all stakeholders — from the public, founders, foundations, and nonprofits to financial
investors.

[ JOURNEY WITH US ][65]

cGMP CRDMO


cGMP-integrated contract research, development, and manufacturing organization. Esco Aster operates
two dedicated certified sites: one focused on clinical medicine, veterinary medicine, and
dermocosmetics; the other focused on clinical cell-based and derivative nutrition, and
nutricosmetics.

[ JOURNEY WITH US ][66]

Advancing the Future of Medicine Through Innovation


At Esco Aster, we empower the development of next-generation medicines by combining advanced
bioprocess solutions, translational research, and scalable manufacturing support. From discovery to
commercialization, we help innovators accelerate breakthroughs in biologics, cell and gene therapy,
vaccines, and regenerative medicine.

[ JOURNEY WITH US ][67]

Enabling Next-Generation Clinical Nutritional Solutions


Esco Aster provides cell-based products and derivatives for clinical and functional nutrition. These
include cell-based meats, proteins, fatty acids, collagen, and other high-value ingredients such as
bird’s nest, deer antler, mitochondria, and milk-/plant-derived extracellular vesicles for
nutraceuticals and supplements.

These products are developed for both companion animals and humans, ensuring clinical benefits for
improved skin health and gut microbiome function. This enables precision nutrition for cancer
patients as well as wellness and longevity applications aimed at increasing health span, not just
lifespan.

# About Esco Aster

Esco Aster is a vertically integrated bioinnovation venture accelerator delivering end-to-end
“idea-to-exit” contract solutions—from consultancy and research to CMC development, manufacturing,
testing, clinical development, business development, strategic capital and enterprise support.

We provide phase-appropriate capabilities that scale with our collaborators, sponsors, and partners
– from early development through GLP Tox, clinical, pilot, demonstration as a CRDMO / CDMO and full
commercial production (CMO).

Founded by scientists, we empower fellow innovators to translate benchwork and intellectual property
into real-world impact.

Through our platforms, we serve the broader bio-based deep tech bioeconomy—spanning life-saving
diagnostics, therapeutics, vaccines, dermatology, dermocosmetics/cosmeceuticals, medical aesthetics/
injectables/coatings, nutraceuticals, and cellular agriculture — delivering high-yield,
cost-effective solutions aligned with self-sufficiency and health technology assessment frameworks.

Our patented, best-in-class manufacturing platforms simplify complexity, enabling reliable, linearly
scalable outcomes. Our technologies have been successfully deployed in multiple commercial human and
animal vaccines, dermocosmetics, as well as in cell-based nutrition and clinical-grade stem cells
and exosomes.

We continuously invest in advancing manufacturing science to address unmet clinical needs, unlocking
bottlenecks across existing and emerging modalities from concept to cure.

Together with our venture ecosystem, we champion an interconnected One World. One Health
approach—bringing innovation to life for people, planet and profit.

Join us in redefining nutrition and medicine for current and future generations.

## About Us

Esco Aster was established in 2015 as an intrapreneurial venture within Esco Lifesciences Group,
following the successful commercialization and patenting of its proprietary biomanufacturing
platform—the packed-bed, adherent Tide Motion bioreactor.

Building on early technical validation achieving commercial success in human and animal vaccines and
market potential, Esco Aster was spun out in 2018 as a wholly owned subsidiary to accelerate product
development, strategic partnerships, and market expansion.

On 8 August 2022, Esco Aster completed its spin-off and now operates as an affiliate of Esco
Lifesciences Group, with increased strategic and operational independence to support its growth
trajectory.

Esco Lifesciences Group, headquartered in Singapore since 1978, was founded by a Singaporean
husband-and-wife team of pharmacists, both graduates of the National University of Singapore. The
Group has since evolved into a globally recognized life sciences platform with a strong track record
in innovation, manufacturing, and commercialization.

THE POWER

TO WIN

THE POWER
TO WIN

 GDLS BRAND FILM

**We Serve Those Who Protect What Matters.**

A trusted partner of forces around the world, we deliver with agility, innovation and exceptional
customer support. Every day, our global team forges ahead into the next era of combat capability,
including autonomy-ready platforms, modern digital architecture and AI-enabled advantages.

That’s why Soldiers and Marines have trusted General Dynamics Land Systems products in the toughest
conditions for decades. We deliver the power to win.

[ Learn More ][36]

### ABOUT GDLS

General Dynamics Land Systems builds the combat vehicles and integrated technologies that give
soldiers a decisive advantage. We design, engineer and sustain advanced tracked and wheeled systems
paired with modern electronic architecture, AI-enabled capabilities and autonomy-ready technology.

From Abrams to LAV, Stryker to AJAX, robotic platforms to software solutions and beyond, our
portfolio delivers proven performance and future-ready modernization for customers around the world.

### Not a career.
### A calling.

Join the people who design, build and advance the systems that protect those who protect us. Our
teams see beyond the horizon, solving problems before they become challenges.

Bring your talent. Bring your purpose.

Let’s shape the future of General Dynamics Land Systems together.

# Enjoy the Best Views in Austin from Mount Bonnell

#### From Mount Bonnell, the high point Austin TX, you have awesome views on Austin, the Colorado
#### River and the Texas Hill Country

[ Visit Mount Bonnell ][23]
 

### What to Do at Mount Bonnell

At the peak you will find Covert Park, an Austin view point with 360-degree views that include the
city skyline and Lake Austin. This free Austin Mount Bonnell experience attracts locals and tourists
from around the world and offers a variety of activities. There are plenty of nearby Lake Austin
hotels and luxury hotels in Austin to provide you with a memorable stay.

[ 10 Reasons to Visit Austin Mt Bonnell ][24]

## About Mount Bonnell

Bonnell Mountain is a great landmark and one of the most visited sites and tourist attractions in
Austin. The limestone height stands at 775 ft above sea level and is considered to be the highest
point within Austin City Limits. It has been a popular sightseeing destination since the mid-19th
century and continues to attract tourists and locals for mountain biking, hiking, and more on the
Mount Bonnel hiking trail. In fact, it’s a favorite for mountain bikers and a Mount Bonell hike is
on the bucket list of many tourists. Mount Bonnell also known as Covert Park belongs, next to other
parks such as Mueller Lake Park and Zilker Park, to the best parks in Austin.

Visit Mt. Bonnell Austin TX and Covert Park at Mount Bonnell trails and enjoy the beauty of the
Austin skyline. If you want to learn more, you can also buy one of many topographic maps with
elevation data and Austin TX Mount Bonnell directions. So, when tourists arrive and ask: Are there
mountains in Austin, Texas? You can tell them to get ready for an exciting walk on the Mt Bonell
stairs to the top. While you’re visiting Bonnell Austin, don’t forget to take in [Circuit of
Americas][25] Austin TX, the country’s premier destination for phenomenal motorsports and live
entertainment. If you’re a diehard sports fan, check out 104.9 The Horn Austin, it’s a local Austin
radio station with station broadcasts in sports format and is the flagship station of the Texas
Longhorns. If My Bonnell has given you an appetite for heights take a trip out to Texas Hill Country
to see the rural countryside of Central Texas with its rugged hills and native vegetation.

If you’re looking for accommodation, you’ll be spoilt for choice, from family hotels to five star
hotels in Austin. [Hotel Saint Cecilia][26] in Austin and [The Loren at Lady Bird Lake][27] both
offer upscale accommodations where you can recover after sightseeing in two of the best Austin
luxury hotels.

[ About Mount Bonnell ][28]

## Mount Bonnell Gallery

Check out our gallery page with beautiful photos of Mount Bonn that other visitors have shared. Why
not share your own favorite pic featuring Mount Bonnell for the chance to win a cool t-shirt?

### Neurology

Neurology is a field in medicine which deals with the study of the Nervous system and treatment of
the respective disorders. The concerned areas of Neurology are the central nervous system (CNS),
peripheral nervous system (PNS), brain, blood vessels, and spinal cord. Neurology is concerned to
diagnose and treat the disorders of these parts of humans. The nervous system is considered a
complex system that regulates body activities. Neurology count on the scientific study of the
nervous system, Neuroscience.

A physician who practices Neurology or doctor specialized in Neurology is called Neurologists.  They
are trained to interpret or investigate and treat the disorders related to the network of nerve
cells and fibers or neurological disorders. Neurologists start with a medical history and then with
the neurological examination which encompasses the evaluation of cranial nerves, sensation,
cognitive function, motor strength, reflexes, coordination, and movement. They treat disorders like:
1. Headache disorders
2. Seizure disorders
3. Speech and Language disorders
4. Movement disorders
5. Neurodegenerative disorders
6. Cerebrovascular diseases

### Neurology

Neurology is a field in medicine which deals with the study of the Nervous system and treatment of
the respective disorders. The concerned areas of Neurology are the central nervous system (CNS),
peripheral nervous system (PNS), brain, blood vessels, and spinal cord. Neurology is concerned to
diagnose and treat the disorders of these parts of humans. The nervous system is considered a
complex system that regulates body activities. Neurology count on the scientific study of the
nervous system, Neuroscience.

A physician who practices Neurology or doctor specialized in Neurology is called Neurologists.  They
are trained to interpret or investigate and treat the disorders related to the network of nerve
cells and fibers or neurological disorders. Neurologists start with a medical history and then with
the neurological examination which encompasses the evaluation of cranial nerves, sensation,
cognitive function, motor strength, reflexes, coordination, and movement. They treat disorders like:
1. Headache disorders
2. Seizure disorders
3. Speech and Language disorders
4. Movement disorders
5. Neurodegenerative disorders
6. Cerebrovascular diseases

## **Best-in-Class** Physicians

We’ve earned our ranking based on our commitment to subspecialized neurosurgical care. Our
physicians complete the safest and most effective procedures in the field, with fellowship training
in vascular neurosurgery, endovascular neurosurgery, skull base surgery, neuro-oncology, functional
neurosurgery, spinal neurosurgery, and pediatric neurosurgery. Our expertise has placed us at the
forefront of neurosurgical care, advancing clinical trials and research as well as teaching medical
students, residents, and fellows.

About Us
We, Paul Medical Systems, are a young and dynamic business that was established in 2011. As a
healthcare instrument manufacturer, we have installed our facility with technologically advanced
machines to manufacture an ample array of hospital instruments. Customer contentment being our
priority, we keep expanding our product range. For this reason, we also work as a trader and deal in
a wide variety of medical instruments including Urology Instruments, Neuro Instruments, Surgical
Instruments, Gynecology Instruments. Keeping quality at the center of everything we do, we offer
Portable Endo Trainer, Yankauer Suction Tube, Digital Electronic Tourniquet, Portable LED Light
Source, Disposable Proctoscope, ICU Equipment and more of nonpareil quality at competitive
prices. Guided by our Director, Mr. Shajan, our team of proficient professionals assist our clients
efficiently while ensuring all the business activities are streamlined. He backing us aids us in
attaining all our targets on-time.

**Reasons to Choose Us**

Our focus on innovation leads us to bring forth such an innovative and advanced medical instruments
that are also affordable. This is why our medical instruments are highly demanded by many healthcare
providers in medical sector, be they small clinics, big hospitals, medical institutes or diagnostics
centers.

  are assisted by many proficient people working together to attain our set targets within the
  predefined time period.

  our business operations in a systematic way. Thus, coming up with innovative and quality-marked
  Digital Tourniquet, ICU Equipment and more of unmatched quality.
* **R&D**: To succeed in a competitive domain, it is imperative to have better insights of the
  market and competitors. Backed by in-house R&D facility, we carry out extensive business research

**Assured Quality, Always!**

of adhering to regulations. Therefore, only top-notch material is sourced from the vendors and a
rigorous examination is carried out at the work stages. Consequently, ensuring flawless
manufacturing of ICU Equipment, Urology Instruments, etc. Besides, we keep a close eye over the
production techniques of medical instruments we source from our vendors.

Cooperation [[News] News ][207] [ProBio CDMO Awards] Awards * [news-image] * [news] * [news-image] [ProBio | GenScript ProBio - Global Biologics CDMO] ## About ProBio # ProBio – Biologics CDMO ProBio, a subsidiary of GenScript Biotech Corporation, is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) that accelerates the discovery, development, and commercialization of biologics and advanced therapies. Combining innovative discovery platforms with integrated development and GMP manufacturing capabilities, ProBio provides end-to-end solutions across antibodies, recombinant proteins, plasmid DNA, mRNA, viral vectors, and in vivo CAR-T therapies. From target discovery and lead optimization through process development, clinical supply, and commercial manufacturing, ProBio helps partners advance complex programs with speed, quality, and confidence. Its scalable technology platforms, global manufacturing network, and deep scientific expertise enable efficient progression from concept to clinic and beyond. Through a collaborative, risk-sharing approach, ProBio also offers flexible licensing and co-development opportunities, helping biotech and pharmaceutical companies reduce development risk, accelerate timelines, and bring innovative therapies to patients faster. ### Contact us For more information about our company and services, please feel free to reach out to our team. # Robot Simulation Software

RoboDK is a complete solution to simulate and program robot arms offline for robot manufacturing and
automation.

[ Download Trial ][47]

## Extensive Robot Library

Up-to-date library of robot arms, manufacturing applications and sample industrial automation
projects.

[Library][48]

## CAD/CAM Software
